privacyPage.title: Privacy & trust
privacyPage.sub: Short version: we publish journeys, never people. HealthPath does not diagnose and does not give medical advice.
privacyPage.banner1: This platform does not provide medical diagnosis or medical advice.
privacyPage.banner2: It only helps users understand anonymous patient journeys.
privacyPage.anonModeText: You do not need an account to read. When you share, your journey is anonymous unless you choose to show your name — the choice is yours, on the form.
privacyPage.notShareNote: Submissions are scanned automatically for email addresses, phone numbers, long ID numbers and street addresses, and rejected if any are found. Names are not detected, so please leave them out yourself.
privacyPage.verifyText: Verification is optional. You can submit without it and request it later. Supporting documents are never shown publicly — only administrators can view them for verification.
privacyPage.levelSelfText: Written by a patient with no document attached. Costs and waits are approximate.
privacyPage.levelDocText: A document is attached and published with the journey. It is not reviewed by anyone, so judge the document for yourself.
privacyPage.trustText: We replaced the old numeric trust score. A number like "72" told readers nothing; how helpful a journey was and whether it has a document tell them more.
privacyPage.abuseText: Any logged-in user can report an experience for privacy exposure, medical-advice claims, offensive content, misleading information, or spam. Moderators review reports and can hide content when needed.
privacyPage.limit1: This is a university MVP, not a production medical system.
privacyPage.limit2: It does not provide diagnosis, treatment, or emergency advice.
privacyPage.limit3: It does not replace doctors or rate medical correctness.
privacyPage.documentsText: If you attach a receipt or referral letter it is published with your journey, and the journey is marked as documented. Nobody reviews uploads before they appear, so remove anything identifying first — the built-in tool blurs images, but PDFs are published exactly as you send them.
privacyPage.removingText: You can remove any journey you shared, at any time, from My journeys. It disappears from the site straight away, along with its document. A copy stays in the database until an administrator clears it.
